name: goat-fluted-studio
description: Fluted Studio · Ховилтой хана: turns photos and clips into a reel on a dark ribbed studio wall with a drifting light beam, a serif italic line over a huge condensed silver Mongolian headline, a status chip and a fan of photo cards that fly up one by one, built on HyperFrames. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
